decisions.reason: Air cooled condensers build directly on the firm's core heat-exchange and cooling capabilities, and increased website prominence signals positive learning.
Like product B, this single-tube air cooled condenser is close to existing knowledge and its own page indicates the firm is investing in it.
Tube liners are adjacent to the firm's maintenance and repair services but are less central, so there is moderate risk of dropping if early results do not show enough learning.
Customized industrial air coolers are a natural extension of the firm's established heat-exchange and cooling portfolio, with multiple models indicating broad application.
Tube end repair inserts fit the lifecycle services business but are also a narrower niche, so the firm may drop them if it cannot quickly assimilate the necessary repair knowledge.
